mapper.sql: c.config_id, c.shop_dept_id, sd.dept_name as shop_dept_name, c.oe_item_id, i.oe_item_code, i.oe_item_name, i.item_description, i.order_unit, i.image_url, i.image_urls, i.purchase_reference_url, i.purchase_reference_note, c.asset_quantity, c.asset_unit_price, c.asset_amount, c.status, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time, c.remark
from oa_fixed_asset_config c left join sys_dept sd on sd.dept_id = c.shop_dept_id left join inv_oe_item i on i.oe_item_id = c.oe_item_id and i.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select coalesce(sum(asset_amount), 0) from oa_fixed_asset_config where shop_dept_id = #{shopDeptId} and status = '0'

select null as config_id, null as shop_dept_id, null as shop_dept_name, i.oe_item_id, i.oe_item_code, i.oe_item_name, i.item_description, i.order_unit, i.image_url, i.image_urls, i.purchase_reference_url, i.purchase_reference_note, null as asset_quantity, i.cost_price as asset_unit_price, null as asset_amount, i.status, i.create_by, i.create_time, i.update_by, i.update_time, i.remark from inv_oe_item i where i.oe_item_id = #{oeItemId} and i.del_flag = '0' and i.status = '0'
